tools.name: elementarypos_list_receipts
tools.description: List sales receipts, filtered by date range, last-modified time or cash register. Good for sales summaries. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/receipt/get-receipts.

tools.name: elementarypos_get_receipt
tools.description: Get one receipt with its items, totals, payment type and cashier. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/receipt/get-receipt.

tools.name: elementarypos_list_open_bills
tools.description: List the open bills (tabs) on the cash registers right now. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/bill/get-bills.

tools.name: elementarypos_get_bill
tools.description: Get one open bill with its name, total, type and customer. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/bill/get-bill.

tools.name: elementarypos_get_order
tools.description: Get one order (items added to a bill) with its state, quantity and note. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/order/get-order.

tools.name: elementarypos_list_cash_journal
tools.description: List the cash journal: cash added to or removed from the drawer, with amount, note and cashier. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/cash-register/get-cash-journal.

tools.name: elementarypos_list_devices
tools.description: List the cash register devices of the account, with name, model, mode and whether each is active. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/cash-register/get-devices.

tools.name: elementarypos_list_items
tools.description: List the sales items (products and services) with price, currency, tax id, category and on-sale flag. Optional filter by category. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/item/get-sales-items.

tools.name: elementarypos_list_categories
tools.description: List the item categories with their parent category and visibility. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/category/get-categories.

tools.name: elementarypos_get_category
tools.description: Get one item category by id. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/category/get-category.

tools.name: elementarypos_get_tax_settings
tools.description: Read the tax rates and tax ids the sales items use. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/tax/get-tax-settings.

tools.name: elementarypos_list_customers
tools.description: List the customers with contact details, loyalty id and loyalty points. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/customer/get-customers.

tools.name: elementarypos_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer with contact details, loyalty points and last visit. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/customer/get-customer.

tools.name: elementarypos_create_customer
tools.description: Create a new customer record. Creates a new record on every call, so check list_customers first. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/customer/create-customer.

tools.name: elementarypos_edit_customer
tools.description: Change a customer's name, e-mail, phone, note or loyalty id. Sends only the fields you pass; the same values again give the same result. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/customer/edit-customer.

tools.name: elementarypos_list_suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers with contact details. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/supplier/get-suppliers.

tools.name: elementarypos_get_supplier
tools.description: Get one supplier by id. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/supplier/get-supplier.

tools.name: elementarypos_get_stock
tools.description: Read the actual stock quantity per item SKU, with unit and a low-stock flag. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/stock/get-actual-stock-data.

tools.name: elementarypos_list_stock_changes
tools.description: List stock changes since a sync timestamp. Returns a new syncTimestamp to pass next time. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/stock/get-stock-changes.

tools.name: elementarypos_add_stock_change
tools.description: Add a stock movement for one SKU (quantity can be negative for a sale or write-off). Use a new request_id for every change: a repeated request_id can be rejected or counted twice. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/stock/add-stock-change.

tools.name: elementarypos_get_webhook_status
tools.description: Read whether the account's POS webhook is active, its URL and any error. Elementary POS API: POST /v1/webhook/get-webhook-status.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow.
